name: AI Posture
description: A unified maturity assertion for human-AI collaboration across in-scope vectors, bounded by the weakest vector.

pre_assessment.label: estimated AI Posture
pre_assessment.notice: This is an estimate, not a verified assertion.

constraint_rule.summary: AI Posture equals the minimum of the in-scope vector levels.

vectors.name: People
vectors.measures: How effectively humans in the organization collaborate with AI.

vectors.name: Infrastructure
vectors.measures: How ready the organization's digital systems are for AI agent interaction.
vectors.artifact_class: Agent-readiness scans, machine-readable declarations, structured identifiers

vectors.name: Regulation
vectors.measures: How completely the organization has met its AI-specific obligations across binding jurisdictions.
vectors.artifact_class: Obligation register with verifiable coverage, recorded interpretations with authorities

levels.name: N/A
levels.meaning: The vector does not apply to this organization at this time.

levels.name: Perceiving
levels.meaning: The organization is aware the domain exists but has not acted.

levels.name: Assessing
levels.meaning: The organization has begun inventorying its state but has no deliberate practice.

levels.name: Integrating
levels.meaning: Deliberate practice is in place and evidence is starting to accumulate.

levels.name: Calibrating
levels.meaning: Practice is measured, tuned, and defensible to outside inspection.

levels.name: Engineering
levels.meaning: Practice is systematized and the organization advances the frontier rather than catching up.
